title: Give every train a typed kebab-case train_id

facts.note: Discovery signal only: YAML files under plan/_trains/ (including nested subdirectories) or elsewhere under plan/ are candidates. Path membership alone does not make a file a train document; README, notes and other non-train auxiliary files in the directory are out of scope.
Train documents are YAML; non-YAML files (e.g. README.md) are never train documents.
Any change to a train document, including edits to non-identity fields; the naming invariants hold for the whole document.
Planning tasks that mention defining, editing, renaming or moving a train.

values: candidate YAML declares its own top-level train_id
facts.note: Content observer to surface candidates (including misplaced train documents outside plan/_trains/ or nested within it). A train_id field is a discovery signal, not proof: registries or files that merely reference train_ids are not train documents.
Final classification: the candidate's purpose is to define one train (its own identity, title and contents), as opposed to an auxiliary, registry or reference-only file.

fires: Planner creates a new train definition document.
Planner edits any field of an existing train definition document, including only its title or only its wagon list.
Planner renames a train, changes its train_id, or moves its definition file.
A train definition document sits in a subdirectory of plan/_trains/, outside plan/_trains/, or under a filename that differs from its train_id.
doesNotFire: Editing a README, notes or other non-train auxiliary file in plan/_trains/.
Editing a registry or other YAML that only references train_ids without defining a train.
Editing wagons, WMBTs or acceptances without creating, editing or moving any train definition document.
Code or doc changes that contain no train definition document.

given: The change set contains a train definition document: a YAML file whose purpose is to define one train (its own train_id, title and contents), wherever it currently sits. Files that only reference trains, and non-train auxiliary files, are not train documents.
when: the planner creates, edits, renames or moves it, or changes its train_id, title or file location
then: Set train_id to the typed identity train:{subject}:{descriptive-name}, with both subject and descriptive name in kebab-case.
prefer: Mandatory, not optional: store the file flat at plan/_trains/{train_id}.yaml, filename taken from the train_id.
Mandatory, not optional: write the title in Title Case.
avoid: Untyped ids missing the train: prefix or the {subject} segment.
camelCase, snake_case, spaces or uppercase in subject or descriptive name.
Titles not in Title Case (e.g. lowercase or a copied kebab-case id).
Nested subdirectories under plan/_trains/, train files outside plan/_trains/, or a filename that differs from the train_id.
Renaming or adding train identity fields to README, registry or other non-train files.
why: A single typed, predictable train_id gives each train one identity from which its file path and references can be derived mechanically.
evidence: Every train definition document sits directly in plan/_trains/ (no nesting, none elsewhere) and its basename equals its train_id.
Each train_id matches train:{subject}:{descriptive-name} with both segments kebab-case.
verifier_detail: train_id pattern: ^train:[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*:[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ (kebab-case subject and descriptive name).
Term train_naming covers train_id, title, and file naming.

Candidate discovery: YAML under plan/ (nested or not) declaring its own top-level train_id; confirm it defines a train before applying checks. Skip non-YAML files and files that only reference train_ids.

additions.justification: Source has no explicit rationale; the file-path derivation follows from S013 (plan/_trains/{train_id}.yaml) and the reference derivation from graph.json edges depending on this rule.
Operationalises 'kebab-case' from the source for a detector; no new obligation.

additions.text: Train document = YAML whose purpose is to define one train; path under plan/_trains/ and a train_id field are discovery signals only; auxiliary, registry and reference-only files excluded; content observer + LLM classification for final scope.
additions.justification: The source constrains train documents but does not define them; this scoping avoids misapplying the rule to non-train files while still detecting nested or misplaced train documents that violate S013. It narrows scope and adds no obligation.

additions.text: Renaming or adding train identity fields to README, registry or other non-train files.
additions.justification: Guard against misapplication identified by review; restates the scope limit, adds no obligation.

additions.text: 'Mandatory, not optional' marker on title and file-location items.
additions.justification: Source states these as part of the rule statement (S006); placed in prefer only because then holds one obligation, so the marker prevents them being read as optional.

additions.text: then keeps only the typed train_id obligation. Title Case (S012) and flat file location (S013) are independently testable and should become planner.train.title-case and planner.train.file-location; until then they remain here in prefer/avoid/evidence/verifier_detail so nothing is lost.
